==================
Backslash continuation as the first line of an indented block
==================

if True:
  \
    1
  \
2
else:
  3
---

(module
  (if_statement
    (true)
    (line_continuation)
    (block
      (expression_statement
        (integer))
      (line_continuation)
      (expression_statement
        (integer)))
    (else_clause
      (block
        (expression_statement
          (integer))))))

==================
Backslash continuations before blank and comment lines
==================

if x:
  \

  3
if y:
  \
 # c
  4
---

(module
  (if_statement
    (identifier)
    (line_continuation)
    (block
      (expression_statement
        (integer))))
  (if_statement
    (identifier)
    (line_continuation)
    (comment)
    (block
      (expression_statement
        (integer)))))
